plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. The fixed input reservation predates new Native calibration. The unchanged enabled-state oracle only checks fixture health, not task-generalization performance. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior.
